Name: Prophet's Deer
Author: TheDeafProphet
Description:
[size=3]Hi folks! Bit of a surprise mod here heh. I've been wanting to practice my sprite work, and had a brief run in with some deer on a trip, which led to me being inspired to do my own take on adding deer into the game. These are intended to be white-tailed doe and fawn that i've added here 


I find the idea of deer milk and cheese a touch off putting, so I opted instead to look into what deer eat and have them bring that back! So, every few days you will either get a common mushroom, or a seasonal fruit, with foraged fruit for the regular drop and crop fruit for their high friendship drop!

The seasonal fruits are:
[list]
[*][size=3]Spring: Salmonberry, Strawberry[/size]
[*][size=3]Summer: Spice berry, Blueberry[/size]
[*][size=3]Fall: Blackberry, Cranberries[/size]
[*][size=3]Winter: Crystal fruit, Powdermelon[/size]
[/list]
[b]How to use mod:[/b] Install both smapi and content patcher prior, then put this mods files inside your mods folder!

[b]How to aquire in game:[/b] The deer can be bought at Marnie's shop after constructing a barn

This is my first time making an animal mod, so apologies if anything is clunky or if the balance is off ^-^. I have some ideas for other animals to add (like giant frogs or moths) but we'll see how it goes! 

Hope y'all enjoy!
